'''Cell Block Command''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military detachment tasked with overseeing the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Odis P. Valyn]] introduced himself as part of the Cell Block Command.
